page.content:
Fortune is a spiritual aspect that can be stored in the metal chromium (as a Feruchemical ability), or which can be used to wipe out the Allomantic reserves of a target (as an Allomantic ability).

Key threads from this canonical page lead to Cosmere, The Stormlight Archive, Stormlight and Chromium. Each link is another long-tail path through the subject.

  • Concept: Stormlight — Fortune's entry mentions Stormlight — Stormlight is a radiant energy given off by highstorms that can be stored in gemstones and then laterthumbused by Surgebinders.
  • Topic: Chromium — Fortune's entry mentions Chromium — Chromium is a chemical element; it has symbol Cr and atomic number 24. It is the first element in group 6. It is a steely-grey, lustrous, hard, and brittle transition metal.

page.overview:
What is Fortune?

Fortune is a spiritual aspect that can be stored in the metal chromium (as a Feruchemical ability), or which can be used to wipe out the Allomantic reserves of a target (as an Allomantic ability).
